legend: In order to keep a fresh supply of clean shirts, you sometimes also do laundry at night, washing all shirts in the laundry basket (including the one you wore that day). This is not according to some neat schedule however; the number of days between your wash cycles is a uniformly random integer between 1$$$1$$$ (in which case you would wash only a single shirt) and the number of shirts you have. After washing your clothes, you put them back on top of the stack in a uniformly random order.

It is now the night after a successful programming contest, and you decide that the T-shirt you got there is your lucky shirt from now on. You wonder when you will be able to wear it again, and entertain yourself with thoughts about the good fortune you will receive when you do. You just completed your laundry and put all your shirts on the stack. Knowing the current position of your lucky shirt in the stack, what is the expected position of your lucky shirt after k$$$k$$$ more washing cycles?
input: One line containing three integers n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤106$$$1\leq n\leq 10^6$$$) the number of shirts you have, i$$$i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1\leq i\leq n$$$), the position of your lucky shirt counted from the top, and k$$$k$$$ (1≤k≤106$$$1\leq k\leq 10^6$$$), the number of washing cycles.
output: Output the expected position of your lucky shirt after k$$$k$$$ washing cycles.  Your answer should have an absolute or relative error of at most 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.

legend.ai: 为了保持干净衬衫的充足供应，你有时也会在晚上洗衣服，把洗衣篮中的所有衬衫都洗掉(包括你当天穿的那件)。不过，这并不是按照某个固定的时间表进行的；两次洗衣之间的天数是一个在 1$$$1$$$(此时你只会洗一件衬衫)和你拥有的衬衫数量之间均匀随机取值的整数。洗完衣服后，你会以均匀随机的顺序将它们放回衣服堆的顶部。
现在是一次成功的程序设计竞赛结束后的晚上，你决定从今以后把在那里得到的 T 恤作为自己的幸运衬衫。你想知道什么时候才能再次穿上它，并且一想到穿上它时将获得的好运就觉得很开心。你刚刚洗完衣服，并把所有衬衫放回了衣服堆中。已知当前幸运衬衫在衣服堆中的位置，求再经过 k$$$k$$$ 次洗衣后，幸运衬衫所在位置的期望值。

input.ai: 一行包含三个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤106$$$1\leq n\leq 10^6$$$)，表示你拥有的衬衫数量；i$$$i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1\leq i\leq n$$$)，表示从顶部开始数的幸运衬衫的位置；以及 k$$$k$$$(1≤k≤106$$$1\leq k\leq 10^6$$$)，表示洗衣次数。

output.ai: 输出你的幸运衬衫经过 k$$$k$$$ 次洗涤后的期望位置。你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差至多为 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$。
